Dear Esteemed Aquant Dealer,

As we embark on a new financial year, we are excited to announce that we at Aquant will officially communicate through WhatsApp for delivering marketing promotions and important company updates.

With this initiative, you can expect:
1.⁠ ⁠Real-time updates on our latest offerings ✅
2.⁠ ⁠Exclusive marketing promotions ✅
3.⁠ ⁠Key announcements to keep you informed and ahead ✅

By consolidating our communication on WhatsApp, we aim to provide a more efficient, convenient, and streamlined experience, ensuring that you never miss out on important information.

Thank you for your continued support— we can’t wait to keep you in the loop! 🤝

Regards,  
Team Aquant
